subject: Fix NB build workflow
body:
Fix NB build workflow

The Build workflow had been failing with MSB4236 "The SDK 'Microsoft.NET.Sdk'
specified could not be found" (upstream has been failing since Feb 2026).

The windows-latest image is now windows-2025-vs2026, so a full Visual Studio
2026 is already installed. The workflow additionally chocolatey-installed
visualstudio2026buildtools with only the VCTools (C++) workload. That second,
C++-only instance shipped no .NET SDK, and setup-msbuild selected it over the
preinstalled VS, so no SDK-style project could resolve Microsoft.NET.Sdk.

Every project in the solution is SDK-style net10.0-windows. They cannot be
built with `dotnet build` either: mRemoteNG.csproj has a COMReference
(MSTSCLib via aximp) and ResolveComReference exists only in the .NET Framework
build of MSBuild (MSB4803). The build therefore needs the preinstalled VS 2026
MSBuild, which compiles against the .NET 10 SDK.

- Drop the choco VS Build Tools install and use the preinstalled VS 2026 via
  setup-msbuild. This also cuts roughly ten minutes off each job.
- Build the mRemoteNG project rather than the solution for self-contained:
  PublishAfterBuild deletes mRemoteNG's own output dir, and mRemoteNGTests
  references mRemoteNG, so a solution build failed with MSB3030.
- Take the self-contained artifact from PublishDir ("Publish Self-Contained")
  instead of overriding PublishDir, and verify the expected output exists
  before zipping so a layout change fails loudly.
- Let MSBuild own the restore so self-contained RID assets match the build.
- Disable TransformOnBuild so the AssemblyInfo.cs generated with the correct
  platform by the dotnet-t4 step is not overwritten during the build.
- Drop the EnvDTE/Interop lookup from the T4 step. AssemblyInfo.ttinclude
  deliberately avoids a compile-time EnvDTE dependency, loads Interop from
  mRemoteNG\libs, and resolves the platform from the PLATFORM env var.
- Pass the t4 parameter as -p:platformType (-P is the assembly reference path
  option
patch:
--- .github/workflows/Build_mR-NB.yml
@@ -22,12 +22,18 @@ jobs:
             arch: x64
             deployment: framework-dependent
             deploy_suffix: FD
+            configuration: Release
+            # OutputPath from mRemoteNG.csproj for 'Release|x64'
+            output_dir: Release
           # Self-Contained builds (includes .NET runtime)
           - runner: windows-latest
             platform: x64
             arch: x64
             deployment: self-contained
             deploy_suffix: SC
+            configuration: Release Self-Contained
+            # PublishDir from mRemoteNG.csproj for 'Release Self-Contained|x64'
+            output_dir: Publish Self-Contained
     runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
     # Only run if:
     # - manual dispatch, OR
@@ -57,46 +63,37 @@ jobs:
             exit 1
           }
 
-      - name: (02) Install .NET 10 SDK
+      - name: (03) Install .NET 10 SDK
         uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
         with:
           dotnet-version: '10.0.x'
 
-      # 6. Install Visual Studio 2026 Build Tools
-      - name: (03) Install Visual Studio 2026 Build Tools
-        shell: pwsh
-        run: |
-          Write-Host "Installing VS 2026 Build Tools..."
-          choco install visualstudio2026buildtools --package-parameters "--add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Workload.VCTools --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 --includeRecommended --quiet" -y --ignore-package-exit-codes=3010
-          Write-Host "VS 2026 Build Tools installation completed"
-          
+      # AssemblyInfo.cs is generated here rather than during the build: the csproj's
+      # TransformOnBuild support lives in the VS-only TextTemplating targets, which are
+      # not present on a dotnet-SDK-only build. AssemblyInfo.ttinclude resolves the
+      # platform from the PLATFORM env var and loads Microsoft.VisualStudio.Interop.dll
+      # from mRemoteNG\libs, so no Visual Studio install is required.
       - name: (04) Install and run dotnet-t4 to transform T4 templates
         shell: pwsh
         run: |
           dotnet tool install --global dotnet-t4
           # Refresh PATH to include global tools
           $env:PATH += ";$env:USERPROFILE\.dotnet\tools"
           $ttFile = "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\mRemoteNG\Properties\AssemblyInfo.tt"
-          
-          Write-Host "Locating required Visual Studio assemblies..."
-          $searchPaths = @("C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio", "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio")
-          
-          $envDte = Get-ChildItem -Path $searchPaths -Filter "EnvDTE.dll" -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
-          $interop = Get-ChildItem -Path $searchPaths -Filter "Microsoft.VisualStudio.Interop.dll" -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
-          
-          if (-not $envDte -or -not $interop) {
-            Write-Host "ERROR: Could not find EnvDTE.dll or Microsoft.VisualStudio.Interop.dll in the Visual Studio directories!" -ForegroundColor Red
+
+          Write-Host "Transforming T4 template..."
+          t4 $ttFile -p:platformType=${{ matrix.platform }}
+
+          $generated = "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\mRemoteNG\Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs"
+          if (-not (Test-Path $generated)) {
+            Write-Host "ERROR: T4 transform did not produce AssemblyInfo.cs!" -ForegroundColor Red
             exit 1
           }
-          
-          Write-Host "Found EnvDTE at: $($envDte.FullName)" -ForegroundColor Green
-          Write-Host "Found Interop at: $($interop.FullName)" -ForegroundColor Green
-          
-          Write-Host "Transforming T4 template..."
-          t4 $ttFile -P platformType=${{ matrix.platform }} -r:"$($envDte.FullName)" -r:"$($interop.FullName)"
+          Write-Host "--- Generated AssemblyInfo.cs ---" -ForegroundColor Green
+          Get-Content $generated | Select-String -Pattern 'AssemblyVersion|AssemblyConfiguration'
         env:
           PLATFORM: '${{ matrix.platform }}'
-  
+
       - name: (05) Cache NuGet Packages
         uses: actions/cache@v6
         with:
@@ -108,24 +105,62 @@ jobs:
             
       - name: (06) Restore NuGet Packages
         shell: pwsh
-        run: dotnet restore
+        run: |
+          dotnet restore "$Env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\$Env:SOLUTION_FILE" `
+            -p:Configuration="${{ matrix.configuration }}" `
+            -p:Platform=${{ matrix.platform }}
 
-      # Add this new step right here:
+      # Resolves the MSBuild from the Visual Studio 2026 install that is already present on the
+      # windows-latest image. mRemoteNG.csproj has a COMReference (MSTSCLib/aximp), and the
+      # ResolveComReference task only exists in the .NET Framework build of MSBuild, so
+      # `dotnet build` cannot build this solution (MSB4803).
       - name: (06.5) Setup MSBuild
         uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v2
-        
-      - name: (07) Build Framework-Dependent Release
-        if: matrix.deployment == 'framework-dependent'
+
+      # 'Release Self-Contained' needs no explicit Publish target: the csproj's PublishAfterBuild
+      # target runs Publish after Build and then deletes the intermediate build dir, leaving the
+      # artifact in PublishDir. TransformOnBuild is disabled so the AssemblyInfo.cs generated with
+      # the correct platform in step (04) is not overwritten by an in-build transform.
+      #
+      # Self-contained builds the mRemoteNG project rather than the solution: PublishAfterBuild
+      # deletes mRemoteNG's own output dir, and mRemoteNGTests references mRemoteNG, so a solution
+      # build races it and fails with MSB3030 (mRemoteNG.dll not found). Framework-dependent has no
+      # such target and builds the whole solution, which also compiles the test project.
+      - name: (07) Build ${{ matrix.deployment }} Release
         shell: pwsh
         run: |
-          msbuild "$Env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\$Env:SOLUTION_FILE" -p:Configuration="Release" -p:Platform=${{ matrix.platform }} /verbosity:minimal
+          if ('${{ matrix.deployment }}' -eq 'self-contained') {
+            $target = "$Env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\mRemoteNG\mRemoteNG.csproj"
+          } else {
+            $target = "$Env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\$Env:SOLUTION_FILE"
+          }
+          Write-Host "Building: $target" -ForegroundColor Cyan
+
+          msbuild "$target" `
+            /restore `
+            -p:Configuration="${{ matrix.configuration }}" `
+            -p:Platform=${{ matrix.platform }} `
+            -p:TransformOnBuild=false `
+            /verbosity:minimal
 
-      - name: (08) Build Self-Contained Release
-        if: matrix.deployment == 'self-contained'
+      - name: (08) Verify build output
         shell: pwsh
         run: |
-          msbuild "$Env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\$Env:SOLUTION_FILE" /t:Publish /p:Configuration="Release Self-Contained" -p:Platform=${{ matrix.platform }} /verbosity:minimal /p:SelfContained=true /p:PublishDir="bin\${{ matrix.platform }}\Release"
-                
+          $sourceDir = "$Env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\mRemoteNG\bin\${{ matrix.platform }}\${{ matrix.output_dir }}"
+          if (-not (Test-Path $sourceDir)) {
+            Write-Host "ERROR: Expected output directory not found: $sourceDir" -ForegroundColor Red
+            Write-Host "Contents of mRemoteNG\bin:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
+            Get-ChildItem "$Env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\mRemoteNG\bin" -Recurse -Directory | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName
+            exit 1
+          }
+          if (-not (Test-Path "$sourceDir\mRemoteNG.exe")) {
+            Write-Host "ERROR: mRemoteNG.exe not found in $sourceDir" -ForegroundColor Red
+            Get-ChildItem $sourceDir | Select-Object -First 40 -ExpandProperty Name
+            exit 1
+          }
+          $count = (Get-ChildItem $sourceDir -Recurse -File).Count
+          Write-Host "Output OK: $sourceDir ($count files)" -ForegroundColor Green
+
       - name: (09) Release Information
         id: version
         shell: pwsh
@@ -184,15 +219,15 @@ jobs:
       - name: (11) Create Zip File
         shell: pwsh
         run: |
-          $sourceDir = "$Env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\mRemoteNG\bin\${{ matrix.platform }}\Release"
+          $sourceDir = "$Env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\mRemoteNG\bin\${{ matrix.platform }}\${{ matrix.output_dir }}"
           Compress-Archive -Path "$sourceDir\*" -DestinationPath ${{ steps.version.outputs.zipname }}
           echo "File: ${{ steps.version.outputs.zipname }}"
           
           # Show file size
           $fileSize = (Get-Item ${{ steps.version.outputs.zipname }}).Length / 1MB
           echo "Size: $([math]::Round($fileSize, 2)) MB"
 
-      - name: (10) Upload artifacts for combination
+      - name: (12) Upload artifacts for combination
         uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
         with:
           name: release-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ matrix.deploy_suffix }}
--- mRemoteNG/mRemoteNG.csproj
@@ -586,5 +586,7 @@
     <RemoveDir Directories="$(TempBuildDir)" />
     <RemoveDir Directories="$(ProjectDir)bin\x64\Release Self-Contained" />
   </Target>
-  <Import Project="$(MSBuildExtensionsPath)\Microsoft\VisualStudio\v18.0\TextTemplating\Microsoft.TextTemplating.targets" />
+  <!-- Only available under a full Visual Studio/MSBuild install. Command-line builds (dotnet build)
+       transform AssemblyInfo.tt up front with dotnet-t4 instead, so skip the import when absent. -->
+  <Import Project="$(MSBuildExtensionsPath)\Microsoft\VisualStudio\v18.0\TextTemplating\Microsoft.TextTemplating.targets" Condition="Exists('$(MSBuildExtensionsPath)\Microsoft\VisualStudio\v18.0\TextTemplating\Microsoft.TextTemplating.targets')" />
 </Project>

security_flags.reason: CI workflow changes are the primary supply-chain vector (pull_request_target abuse, workflow injection)
a new or repointed package can pull arbitrary code at restore time

triage.rationale: Fork-of-our-fork repairing its own NB workflow. Our CI already restructured (windows-2025-vs2026, 2-release model, all GREEN). Fix targets divergent workflow state.
